== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] resembles the icon of the Ranger skill [[Body Shot]].
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Shell Shock/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
* "[[w:Shell shock|Shell shock]]" is a slang term for combat stress reaction, first used during World War I. The term is widely used in pop culture, including as an exclamation uttered by [[w:Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles|Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles]].
